Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning (PPFL) Testbed and Curated Dataset

October 29, 2026

The National Cybersecurity Center of Excellence released an open-source Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning testbed and curated genomic dataset.

The testbed supports research on privacy-preserving methods for training machine learning models across distributed datasets. Researchers can evaluate the methods without centralizing sensitive records.

NIST made the testbed and dataset available to support reproducible evaluation and further research into privacy-enhancing technologies.
